images.title: Plot each point, then join
images.purpose: Shows the core move of the line graph builder: placing a point by reading across from the scale, then joining it to the line.
images.composition: One clean grid with a single line already joined for six days; the seventh point is being placed with dashed guide lines to both axes. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: A light grey grid. The horizontal axis has 7 evenly spaced ticks for the days Monday to Sunday; only the first is labelled 'Mon' and the last is labelled 'Sun', the middle 5 ticks have no labels. The vertical axis runs from 0 to 40 with 9 ticks every 5; numerals only at 0, 20 and 40, the others have no numerals. Vertical axis title 'visiting customers'. Six teal (#0072B2) dots at Mon 16, Tue 19, Wed 10, Thu 14, Fri 20, Sat 22, joined in order by a teal line. A seventh, larger reddish purple (#CC79A7) dot at Sun 35, with a dashed grey line down to the Sun tick and a dashed grey line across to the vertical axis, where the label '35' sits. A short teal dashed segment joins the Sat dot to the Sun dot. Exactly 7 dots, 1 line.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Find the day, go up to the value, mark the point, then join it to the last one.
